domain_payload.statement: Every even integer n with 2 < n <= 10000 is the sum of two primes.

core_task_draft.title: Bounded synthetic number-theory check
core_task_draft.problem_statement: Verify the conjecture for even n up to 10000 with explicit prime witnesses, or produce a counterexample.
completion_criteria: Every even n in range has two prime witnesses recorded, or one counterexample is produced.
